@@ -0,0 +1,367 @@
+"""Safe image loading utilities with SSRF protection.
+
+Loads images from:
+- ``data:image/...`` URLs (decoded locally, no network access)
+- Application object storage (relative paths or ``settings.STORAGE_HOST`` URLs)
+- Public HTTP/HTTPS URLs (only after DNS resolution, public-IP verification,
+  connection IP pinning, proxy bypass prevention, and per-hop redirect checks)
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import binascii
+import io
+import ipaddress
+import socket
+from typing import Optional
+from urllib.parse import unquote, urljoin, urlsplit
+
+import requests
+from PIL import Image
+from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
+from urllib3.connection import HTTPConnection, HTTPSConnection
+from urllib3.connectionpool import HTTPConnectionPool, HTTPSConnectionPool
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.core.logging import get_logger
+from app.services.storage import storage
+
+logger = get_logger(__name__)
+
+MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = 50 * 1024 * 1024  # 50 MiB
+MAX_REDIRECTS = 5
+
+_BLOCKED_HOST_SUFFIXES = (".localhost", ".local", ".internal", ".arpa")
+_NAT64_NETS = (
+    ipaddress.IPv6Network("64:ff9b::/96"),
+    ipaddress.IPv6Network("64:ff9b:1::/48"),
+)
+_CGNAT_NET = ipaddress.IPv4Network("100.64.0.0/10")
+
+
+class UnsafeImageURLError(ValueError):
+    """Raised when an image source URL is malformed or points to a disallowed target."""
+
+
+def _is_public_ip_obj(ip: ipaddress.IPv4Address | ipaddress.IPv6Address) -> bool:
+    """Return True only if *ip* is a globally routable unicast address."""
+    if isinstance(ip, ipaddress.IPv6Address):
+        if ip.ipv4_mapped is not None:
+            return _is_public_ip_obj(ip.ipv4_mapped)
+        if ip.sixtofour is not None:
+            return _is_public_ip_obj(ip.sixtofour)
+        if ip.teredo is not None:
+            client_ip, server_ip = ip.teredo
+            return _is_public_ip_obj(client_ip) and _is_public_ip_obj(server_ip)
+        if any(ip in net for net in _NAT64_NETS):
+            return False
+    else:
+        if ip in _CGNAT_NET:
+            return False
+
+    return (
+        ip.is_global
+        and not ip.is_private
+        and not ip.is_loopback
+        and not ip.is_link_local
+        and not ip.is_multicast
+        and not ip.is_reserved
+        and not ip.is_unspecified
+    )
+
+
+def is_public_ip(ip_str: str) -> bool:
+    """Return True only if *ip_str* parses as a globally routable unicast IP."""
+    try:
+        ip = ipaddress.ip_address(ip_str)
+    except ValueError:
+        return False
+    return _is_public_ip_obj(ip)
+
+
+def _effective_port(parts) -> Optional[int]:
+    try:
+        if parts.port is not None:
+            return parts.port
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+    scheme = parts.scheme.lower()
+    if scheme == "http":
+        return 80
+    if scheme == "https":
+        return 443
+    return None
+
+
+def _is_safe_storage_rel_path(rel_path: str) -> bool:
+    if not rel_path or "\x00" in rel_path or "\\" in rel_path or rel_path.startswith("/"):
+        return False
+    for candidate in (rel_path, unquote(rel_path)):
+        parts = candidate.split("/")
+        if any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in parts):
+            return False
+    return True
+
+
+def extract_storage_relative_path(url: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """If *url* points to ``settings.STORAGE_HOST``, return its validated storage key.
+
+    Raises ``UnsafeImageURLError`` if it targets ``STORAGE_HOST`` with a traversal
+    or malformed path. Returns ``None`` if *url* does not match ``STORAGE_HOST``.
+    """
+    storage_host = (settings.STORAGE_HOST or "").strip().rstrip("/")
+    if not storage_host:
+        return None
+
+    storage_parts = urlsplit(storage_host)
+    if (
+        storage_parts.scheme.lower() not in ("http", "https")
+        or not storage_parts.hostname
+        or storage_parts.hostname == "None"
+    ):
+        return None
+
+    parsed = urlsplit(url)
+    if parsed.scheme.lower() != storage_parts.scheme.lower():
+        return None
+    if parsed.username is not None or parsed.password is not None:
+        return None
+    if not parsed.hostname or parsed.hostname.lower() != storage_parts.hostname.lower():
+        return None
+    if _effective_port(parsed) != _effective_port(storage_parts):
+        return None
+
+    storage_prefix = storage_parts.path.rstrip("/") + "/"
+    if not parsed.path.startswith(storage_prefix):
+        return None
+
+    if parsed.query or parsed.fragment:
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Storage URL must not include query or fragment")
+
+    rel_path = unquote(parsed.path[len(storage_prefix):])
+    if not _is_safe_storage_rel_path(rel_path):
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Invalid storage object path")
+    return rel_path
+
+
+def _has_control_chars(value: str) -> bool:
+    return any(ord(ch) < 32 or ord(ch) == 127 for ch in value)
+
+
+def _is_non_canonical_numeric_host(hostname: str) -> bool:
+    """Reject octal/hex/integer IPv4 forms such as 2130706433, 0x7f000001, 0177.0.0.1."""
+    try:
+        ipaddress.ip_address(hostname)
+        return False
+    except ValueError:
+        pass
+
+    labels = hostname.split(".")
+    if all(label and (label.isdigit() or label.lower().startswith("0x")) for label in labels):
+        return True
+    return False
+
+
+def validate_and_resolve_external_url(url: str) -> str:
+    """Validate an external HTTP/HTTPS URL and return a pinned public IP address."""
+    if _has_control_chars(url):
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("URL contains control characters")
+
+    parsed = urlsplit(url)
+    scheme = parsed.scheme.lower()
+    if scheme not in ("http", "https"):
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError(f"Unsupported URL scheme: {scheme or '<empty>'}")
+    if parsed.username is not None or parsed.password is not None:
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Credentials in URL are not allowed")
+
+    hostname = (parsed.hostname or "").rstrip(".").strip()
+    if not hostname or _has_control_chars(hostname) or any(c in hostname for c in ("\\", "@", "%", " ")):
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Invalid URL hostname")
+
+    port = _effective_port(parsed)
+    if port is None or not (1 <= port <= 65535):
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Invalid URL port")
+
+    lower_host = hostname.lower()
+    if lower_host == "localhost" or any(lower_host.endswith(suffix) for suffix in _BLOCKED_HOST_SUFFIXES):
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError(f"Disallowed hostname: {hostname}")
+
+    if _is_non_canonical_numeric_host(hostname):
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError(f"Disallowed numeric hostname: {hostname}")
+
+    # Fast check for IP literals before invoking DNS resolver.
+    try:
+        literal_ip = ipaddress.ip_address(hostname)
+    except ValueError:
+        literal_ip = None
+    if literal_ip is not None and not _is_public_ip_obj(literal_ip):
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError(f"Disallowed IP address: {hostname}")
+
+    try:
+        addr_info = socket.getaddrinfo(hostname, port, type=socket.SOCK_STREAM)
+    except socket.gaierror as exc:
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError(f"Failed to resolve hostname '{hostname}': {exc}") from exc
+
+    if not addr_info:
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError(f"Hostname '{hostname}' resolved to no addresses")
+
+    resolved_ips: list[str] = []
+    for _, _, _, _, sockaddr in addr_info:
+        ip_str = sockaddr[0]
+        if "%" in ip_str or not is_public_ip(ip_str):
+            raise UnsafeImageURLError(f"Disallowed resolved IP address '{ip_str}' for '{hostname}'")
+        if ip_str not in resolved_ips:
+            resolved_ips.append(ip_str)
+
+    return resolved_ips[0]
+
+
+def _make_pinned_adapter(pinned_ip: str) -> HTTPAdapter:
+    """Create an HTTPAdapter that connects TCP to *pinned_ip* while keeping SNI/Host."""
+
+    class PinnedHTTPConnection(HTTPConnection):
+        def _new_conn(self):
+            self._dns_host = pinned_ip
+            return super()._new_conn()
+
+    class PinnedHTTPSConnection(HTTPSConnection):
+        def _new_conn(self):
+            self._dns_host = pinned_ip
+            return super()._new_conn()
+
+    class PinnedHTTPPool(HTTPConnectionPool):
+        ConnectionCls = PinnedHTTPConnection
+
+    class PinnedHTTPSPool(HTTPSConnectionPool):
+        ConnectionCls = PinnedHTTPSConnection
+
+    class PinnedAdapter(HTTPAdapter):
+        def init_poolmanager(self, connections, maxsize, block=False, **pool_kwargs):
+            super().init_poolmanager(connections, maxsize, block=block, **pool_kwargs)
+            self.poolmanager.pool_classes_by_scheme = {
+                "http": PinnedHTTPPool,
+                "https": PinnedHTTPSPool,
+            }
+
+    return PinnedAdapter()
+
+
+def _fetch_external_url(url: str, *, timeout: int, max_bytes: int = MAX_IMAGE_BYTES) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    current_url = url
+    for _ in range(MAX_REDIRECTS + 1):
+        pinned_ip = validate_and_resolve_external_url(current_url)
+        session = requests.Session()
+        session.trust_env = False
+        adapter = _make_pinned_adapter(pinned_ip)
+        session.mount("http://", adapter)
+        session.mount("https://", adapter)
+
+        try:
+            with session.get(current_url, timeout=timeout, allow_redirects=False, stream=True) as resp:
+                if resp.status_code in (301, 302, 303, 307, 308):
+                    location = resp.headers.get("Location")
+                    if not location:
+                        return None
+                    current_url = urljoin(current_url, location)
+                    continue
+
+                if resp.status_code != 200:
+                    logger.warning("Failed to download external image", url=current_url, status_code=resp.status_code)
+                    return None
+
+                chunks = bytearray()
+                for chunk in resp.iter_content(chunk_size=65536):
+                    if not chunk:
+                        continue
+                    if len(chunks) + len(chunk) > max_bytes:
+                        logger.warning("External image exceeded size limit", url=current_url, max_bytes=max_bytes)
+                        return None
+                    chunks.extend(chunk)
+                return bytes(chunks)
+        finally:
+            session.close()
+
+    logger.warning("Too many redirects while downloading image", url=url)
+    return None
+
+
+def _decode_data_image_url(url: str) -> bytes:
+    if "," not in url:
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Malformed data URL")
+    header, encoded = url.split(",", 1)
+    header_lower = header.lower()
+    if not header_lower.startswith("data:image/"):
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Only data:image/* data URLs are allowed")
+    if ";base64" not in header_lower:
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Only base64-encoded data:image/* URLs are supported")
+
+    compact = "".join(encoded.split())
+    try:
+        return base64.b64decode(compact, validate=True)
+    except (binascii.Error, ValueError) as exc:
+        raise UnsafeImageURLError("Invalid base64 image data URL") from exc
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(
+    source: Optional[str],
+    *,
+    timeout: int = 10,
+    raise_on_unsafe: bool = False,
+) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Load image bytes from a data:image URL, our storage, or a safe public HTTP(S) URL."""
+    if not source or not isinstance(source, str):
+        return None
+
+    cleaned = source.strip()
+    if not cleaned:
+        return None
+
+    try:
+        # 1. data: URLs (local decode only)
+        if cleaned.lower().startswith("data:"):
+            return _decode_data_image_url(cleaned)
+
+        # 2. Full URL pointing to our own storage host
+        storage_rel = extract_storage_relative_path(cleaned)
+        if storage_rel is not None:
+            return storage.download_image(storage_rel)
+
+        # 3. Relative path in our storage (no scheme, no netloc)
+        parsed = urlsplit(cleaned)
+        if not parsed.scheme and not parsed.netloc and not parsed.query and not parsed.fragment:
+            if not _has_control_chars(cleaned) and _is_safe_storage_rel_path(cleaned):
+                return storage.download_image(cleaned)
+            raise UnsafeImageURLError("Invalid relative storage path")
+
+        # 4. External HTTP(S) URL (strict SSRF protection)
+        return _fetch_external_url(cleaned, timeout=timeout)
+    except UnsafeImageURLError as exc:
+        logger.warning("Blocked unsafe image source", source=cleaned[:120], reason=str(exc))
+        if raise_on_unsafe:
+            raise
+        return None
+    except Exception as exc:
+        logger.warning("Failed to load image", source=cleaned[:120], error=str(exc))
+        return None
+
+
+def load_pil_image(
+    source: Optional[str],
+    *,
+    timeout: int = 10,
+    mode: Optional[str] = None,
+    raise_on_unsafe: bool = False,
+) -> Optional[Image.Image]:
+    """Load an image via ``load_image_bytes`` and decode it as a PIL Image."""
+    img_bytes = load_image_bytes(source, timeout=timeout, raise_on_unsafe=raise_on_unsafe)
+    if not img_bytes:
+        return None
+    try:
+        img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_bytes))
+        img.load()
+        if mode and img.mode != mode:
+            img = img.convert(mode)
+        return img
+    except Exception as exc:
+        logger.warning("Failed to decode PIL image", source=(source or "")[:120], error=str(exc))
+        return None

+import base64

+def _setup_episode(client, headers):
+    proj = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": "Missing Cuts Ep", "genres": []})
+    assert proj.status_code == 200, proj.text
+    ep = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": proj.json()["id"], "episode_order": 1, "story_summary": "sum"},
+    )
+    assert ep.status_code == 200, ep.text
+    return ep.json()["id"]
+
+
+def test_export_with_no_missing_cuts_omits_missing_txt_and_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _setup_episode(client, h)
+
+    rel_path = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="cuts", identifier="ok-1")
+    data_url = f"data:image/png;base64,{base64.b64encode(PNG).decode('ascii')}"
+
+    for order, path in [(1, rel_path), (2, data_url)]:
+        r = client.post(
+            "/api/v1/cuts",
+            headers=h,
+            json={"episode_id": episode_id, "cut_order": order, "script": f"cut {order}", "image_path": path},
+        )
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+
+    zip_r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+    assert zip_r.status_code == 200, zip_r.text
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in zip_r.headers
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(zip_r.content)) as zf:
+        assert "missing.txt" not in zf.namelist()
+        assert len(zf.namelist()) == 2
+
+    strip_r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=webtoon", headers=h)
+    assert strip_r.status_code == 200, strip_r.text
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in strip_r.headers
+
+
+def test_export_reports_all_missing_cut_reasons_in_missing_txt_and_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = _setup_episode(client, h)
+
+    valid_data_url = f"data:image/png;base64,{base64.b64encode(PNG).decode('ascii')}"
+    unreadable_data_url = f"data:image/png;base64,{base64.b64encode(b'not-a-valid-image').decode('ascii')}"
+
+    # Cut 1: valid image
+    # Cut 2: no image yet (None)
+    # Cut 3: refused internal URL
+    # Cut 4: missing object in storage (cannot be loaded)
+    # Cut 5: valid image
+    # Cut 6: invalid/corrupt image bytes (unreadable by PIL in webtoon format)
+    cuts_spec = [
+        (1, valid_data_url),
+        (2, None),
+        (3, "http://127.0.0.1:9999/secret"),
+        (4, "cuts/nonexistent/missing.png"),
+        (5, valid_data_url),
+        (6, unreadable_data_url),
+    ]
+    for order, path in cuts_spec:

+            "/api/v1/cuts",

+    class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+        def do_GET(self):
+            hits.append(self.path)
+            self.send_response(200)
+            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
+            self.end_headers()
+            self.wfile.write(b"INTERNAL-SECRET-PAYLOAD")

+        def log_message(self, format, *args):

+    server = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
+    port = server.server_address[1]
+    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
+    thread.start()
+    try:
+        yield SimpleNamespace(port=port, base_url=f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}", hits=hits)
+    finally:
+        server.shutdown()

+def test_dns_rebinding_mixed_ips_and_redirects_blocked(monkeypatch, internal_server):
+    # Mixed DNS result containing a public IP and an internal IP must be rejected
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        socket,
+        "getaddrinfo",
+        lambda host, port, type=None: [
+            (socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM, 6, "", ("93.184.216.34", port)),
+            (socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM, 6, "", ("127.0.0.1", port)),
+        ],
+    )
+    assert load_image_bytes("https://dual.example.com/img.png") is None
+
+    # Public DNS followed by redirect to internal IP must never request the internal target
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        socket,
+        "getaddrinfo",
+        lambda host, port, type=None: (
+            [(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM, 6, "", ("127.0.0.1", port))]
+            if host in ("127.0.0.1", "localhost")
+            else [(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM, 6, "", ("93.184.216.34", port))]
+        ),
+    )
+
+    seen_urls: list[str] = []
+
+    class FakeResponse:
+        def __init__(self, status_code, headers=None, content=b""):
+            self.status_code = status_code
+            self.headers = headers or {}
+            self._content = content
+
+        def iter_content(self, chunk_size=65536):
+            yield self._content
+
+        def __enter__(self):
+            return self
+
+        def __exit__(self, *args):
+            return False
+
+    def fake_session_get(self, url, **kwargs):
+        seen_urls.append(url)
+        if url == "https://public.example.com/redirect":
+            return FakeResponse(302, headers={"Location": f"{internal_server.base_url}/secret"})
+        if url == "https://public.example.com/ok.png":
+            return FakeResponse(200, content=PNG)
+        return FakeResponse(404)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests.Session, "get", fake_session_get)
+
+    assert load_image_bytes("https://public.example.com/redirect") is None
+    assert seen_urls == ["https://public.example.com/redirect"]
+    assert internal_server.hits == []
+
+    # Valid public URL still works
+    assert load_image_bytes("https://public.example.com/ok.png") == PNG
